outputs.name: compliance-validation
outputs.desc: Pass/fail compliance validation for the shipment

outputs.name: cold-chain-record
outputs.desc: Complete cold chain record for regulatory and quality purposes

process: Compare the temperature log against the required profiles
Evaluate any excursions against the acceptable limits
Determine pass or fail for the shipment
Produce the complete cold chain record for archival
